ranked_facts.why: The presence of a high serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre is strongly indicative of Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder (NMOSD), which is a specific type of demyelinating disorder, and less likely to be associated with other types of demyelinating disorders, inflammatory disorders, neoplastic disorders, or vascular disorders.

The persistently negative CSF oligoclonal bands are more characteristic of Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder (NMOSD) than Multiple Sclerosis, helping to differentiate between these two demyelinating disorders.
